original_a19_claim: Conducted in-depth score, label, and mask audit ruling out software defects for below-random ROC-AUC on Elliptic/DGraphFin

original_a19_claim: Recommends DLG-Base / DOMINANT for large-scale graphs (N > 10^6); recommends CoLA for extreme imbalance (Elliptic)
a20_corrected_claim: Distinguishes full-graph executability from predictive utility: DLG-Base/DOMINANT are supported starting points for N>10^6 but perform near no-skill prevalence (AP ~0.010 vs 0.0127); CoLA is a comparator below prevalence (0.0947 vs 0.0976)
evidence_basis: DGraphFin AP (0.0101, 0.0102 vs 0.0127); Elliptic AP (0.0947 vs 0.0976)

original_a19_claim: Highlights +50.97% relative improvement on Elliptic over DLG-Base; claims 'clear utility in sparse transaction graphs'

evidence_basis: Frozen paired AP differences: Elliptic +0.0350, Reddit -0.0656, ETH +0.0253, BSC +0.0021, Polygon -0.0124

original_a19_claim: Claims 'clear gains' on Ethereum and disproves universal benefit

evidence_basis: Asymptotic matrix bounds (4*N^2 bytes) and illustrative profile estimates
evidence_tier_or_count: Theoretical lower bounds vs illustrative profiles
